entities.summary: Cucuteni–Trypillia culture is a archaeological culture primarily associated with Europe, spanning from 5400 BCE to 2649 BCE. It marks a significant chapter in the development of human societies. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 40 language editions of Wikipedia.
